observations: body L1-L2: the Greek ὅπερ τῷ Πτολεμαίῳ οὐ δοκεῖ is Theon's (p. 298, note 1); the breathing and the accent of ὅπερ print joined to the omicron, like δ, and a point before Πτολεμαίῳ is a speck. The n of «doctrinam» (L2) prints broken.

body L3-L9: «qnoque» (L3) is printed with a turned u, like n, and kept as printed; «Proclum» is letter-spaced, and the o of «saeculo» prints broken. «Chaldaeo–Aegyptiam» (L4) has a long dash (5.2 pt). The t of «institutis» and the d of «deduxerat» (L6) print broken.

body L10-L21: «Eudoxo», «Metone», «Letronne», «Martin», «Columella», divided between L11 and L12, «Hipparchus», «Eudoxum», divided between L12 and L13, «Schiaparelli», «Hipparchi» and «Gemini» are letter-spaced; a mark over the c of «Hipparchi» (L17) is a speck. Meton observed the summer solstice at Athens in 432 B.C. (Ptolemy, Almagest III, 1), in the later half of the fifth century B.C.; the printed «priore medietate» is kept. Half of 15° is 7° 1/2, which lies in the eighth degree, as printed (L21).
notes_left L1-L6: «Ptolémée» and «Proclus Diadochus» are letter-spaced.

notes_left L7-L8: «Letronne» and «Martin» are letter-spaced; the dash of «106–110» is joined to the 6 and is long (4.5 pt), «445-447» has a hyphen (3.1 pt). A point under the r of «Martin» is a speck.

notes_left L9-L17: Columella, De re rustica IX, 14, 12. The dots after «conficitur.» are five. The eighth day before the Kalends of April is 25 March. The i of «primis» and the t of «partibus» print broken.
notes_left L18-L28: the dots after «Librae.» (L24) and before «Eudoxus» (L27) are five each.
notes_right L1-L2: the Greek θεριναὶ τροπαί, «the summer turnings», is set as printed.
notes_right L10: the hyphen of «secan-» prints on the baseline, like a full stop.
notes_right L15-L21: the dash before «Ab» measures 7.7 pt; «Gemini» and «Schiaparelli» are letter-spaced. The Callippic period began in 330 B.C., as printed.
notes_right L22-L28: «Tannery» is letter-spaced; the i of «Hipparchus» (L24) prints broken, and the dots after «Cnidien» are five.

transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
